Specification: A puzzle spec (Car Talk: divide a 40-pound stone into 4 pieces to weigh any integer 1..40 on a balance). Generalized to constants W and N: TLC enumerates ordered partitions of W into N parts and tests whether each weight in 1..W can be expressed as a signed sum of pieces.
AssumptionNames: \/ \E p \in Partitions(<< >>, W) : IF \A wt \in 1..W : Weighs(p, wt) THEN PrintT(p) ELSE FALSE \/ PrintT("No solution")
